Wade through lots of [[undead]], evil [[plant]]s, [[troll]]s, [[minotaur]]s, and possibly [[White Mantle]] to reach the [[Wizard's Tower]] and kill [[Galrath]].

== Quest information ==

=== Objectives ===
* Seek out [[Galrath]] at the wizard's tower in [[Kessex Peak]]. Put an end to his villainy.
* Return to [[Firstwatch Sergio]] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 4,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Cruel Staff]]
** [[Energy]] +6
** [[Dark Dmg]]: 7-13 (Requires 6 [[Blood Magic]])
** Damage +15% (vs. Hexed foes)
** Armor +5 (while Attacking)
** Two-handed
* Furious [[Long Sword]] of Fortitude
** [[Slashing Dmg]]: 13-19 (Requires 6 [[Swordsmanship]])
** [[Health]] +25
** Double adrenaline gain (Chance: 10%)

== Walkthrough ==
# Starting from the [[Temple of the Ages]] (in order to have a maximum party size of 8) head south through [[The Black Curtain]] towards [[Kessex Peak]]. You will immediately encounter a group of [[Reed Stalker]]s. After defeating the Stalkers follow the path leading to the southeast, making sure to avoid the poisonous water whenever possible. You will soon come upon a [[Damned Cleric]], who once [[aggro]]ed will be accompanied by [[Smoke Phantom]]s and a [[Wraith]]. Be sure to dispatch these foes quickly or [[pull]] them to the west, because a group of [[Hellhound]]s and a [[Necrid Horseman]] will be patrolling the area.
# Continue following the path to the southeast, making sure to watch for more [[Undead]], until you come to a three-way intersection. Take the southern path where you will soon run out of land and be forced to head west to circle around the poisonous swamp. You will encounter a group of [[Ancient Oakheart]], possibly including the [[Tree of Judgment]], as well as some [[Bog Skale Blighter]]s and the occasional [[Spined Aloe]].
# When you come upon a path follow it to the east, being sure to cross over the bridge to avoid the fetid water. You will come upon another group of [[Reed Stalker]]s as well as several [[Forest Minotaur]]s. Continue heading east until you reach the portal to [[Kessex Peak]].
# In Kessex Peak, continue south, passing over the next bridge where you will encounter some [[Fog Nightmare]]s and more Reed Stalkers. After dispatching the monsters turn towards the southwest and follow the canyon towards the Krytan coast. Be sure to watch out for Nightmares and Aloes that will pop out of the ground while you fight the Reed Stalkers that patrol the canyon.
# Once you reach the end of the canyon turn south on the  nearby path. [[Fen Troll]]s will be patrolling the path along with Ancient Oakhearts, and Forest Minotaurs. The Trolls and Minotaurs have very large patrol areas, so be especially careful not to find yourself stuck between two groups of enemies. When you come to the area where there are about 20 of them guarding the path, study their pattern of movement and aggro them from the north, one group at a time. Continue to follow the path to the southwest until you come to a floating castle overlooking a plateau. Head east until you come to a path leading up to where Galrath and his bandits are waiting.
# You will find large groups of [[Verata the Necromancer]]'s [[Cult of Verata|cultists]] blocking your path. Be careful to only aggro one group at a time; dispatching Verata's army is not easy and aggroing more than one group means almost certain death for lower-level groups or henchmen. If players or henchmen have obtained a high death penalty it may be very difficult to kill even one group. If this happens, it is possible with the right timing to slip past the cult and engage Galrath and his bandits. The [[Apprentice of Verata|Apprentices of Verata]] will spawn Bone Fiends so a Necromancer with [[corpse]] [[Corpse#Exploiting a Corpse|exploitation]] skills of their own can be very useful. A [[minion master]] may not be the best however, as the Apprentices will use [[Verata's Gaze]] to steal your minions. After defeating the cultists, head west and kill the bandits before taking on Galrath himself.
# Once you have killed [[Galrath]], simply [[map travel]] to [[Lion's Arch]] and see Sergio for your reward.


You may be able to find easier groups to fight through if, once you get to the main plateau area, you follow the northern edge from west to east, then south along the eastern edge along a path inhabited by a few [[Hill Giant]]s. This path will also aid you if you are working on the [[cartographer]] [[title]].

Similarly, pulling some of the groups away from the plateau may make the task of reaching Galrath slightly easier.

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial dialogue ===
'''Firstwatch Sergio'''
: ''"'''Galrath''' must be stopped! If he gains whatever secrets are locked within the [[Wizard's Tower|wizard's tower]] in '''Kessex Peak''', gods be merciful, I know not who to trust within the [[Lionguard]]. So many I thought beyond reproach are still loyal to him. I need an outsider to find Galrath and put an end to his villainy. You are the only one who has a chance of defeating him."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll stop him!
| decline = Hunt him down yourself.

|indent = :: }}

=== Reward dialogue ===
'''Firstwatch Sergio'''
: ''"The people of Kryta may finally sleep easy, knowing Galrath will never return to do them harm again." ''

== Notes ==
* The Long Sword which is given as a reward has a 10% furious mod which can be salvaged.
* You do not need to kill every bandit to complete the quest, although it does make it easier to kill [[Galrath]].
* Bringing [[Frozen Soil]] can help to suppress resurrection by [[White Mantle]] foes if the [[War in Kryta]] is active, as well as by [[Shepherd of Verata|Shepherds of Verata]].
